lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਇਕੋ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevan pad nirabaan iko simareeai ||
lines.translation: To obtain the state of life of Nirvaanaa, meditate in remembrance on the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਧੀਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojee naahee jaai kin bidh dheereeai ||
lines.translation: There is no other place; how else can we be comforted?

lines.gurmukhi: ਡਿਠਾ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dithaa sabh sa(n)saar sukh na naam bin ||
lines.translation: I have seen the whole world - without the Lord's Name, there is no peace at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹੋਸੀ ਛਾਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ਜਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan dhan hosee chhaar jaanai koi jan ||
lines.translation: Body and wealth shall return to dust - hardly anyone realizes this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗ ਰੂਪ ਰਸ ਬਾਦਿ ਕਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਾਣੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ra(n)g roop ras baad k karahi paraaneeaa ||
lines.translation: Pleasure, beauty and delicious tastes are useless; what are you doing, O mortal?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਲ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis bhulaae aap tis kal nahee jaaneeaa ||
lines.translation: One whom the Lord Himself misleads, does not understand His awesome power.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਸਚਾ ਗਾਵਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ra(n)g rate nirabaan sachaa gaavahee ||
lines.translation: Those who are imbued with the Love of the Lord attain Nirvaanaa, singing the Praises of the True One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saran duaar je tudh bhaavahee ||2||
lines.translation: Nanak: those who are pleasing to Your Will, O Lord, seek Sanctuary at Your Door. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ja(n)man maran na tinh kau jo har laR laage ||
lines.translation: Those who are attached to the hem of the Lord's robe, do not suffer birth and death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevat se paravaan hoe har keeratan jaage ||
lines.translation: Those who remain awake to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises - their lives are approved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਜਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੇਈ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g jin paaiaa seee vadabhaage ||
lines.translation: Those who attain the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, are very fortunate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਵਿਸਰਿਐ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਤੂਟੇ ਕਚ ਧਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai visariai dhrig jeevanaa toote kach dhaage ||
lines.translation: But those who forget the Name - their lives are cursed, and broken like thin strands of thread.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਧੂੜਿ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਸਾਧ ਲਖ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਿਰਾਗੇ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak dhooR puneet saadh lakh kot piraage ||16||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the dust of the feet of the Holy is more sacred than hundreds of thousands, even millions of cleansing baths at sacred shrines. ||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਣਿ ਸੁਵੰਨੀ ਖੜ ਰਤਨ ਜੜਾਵੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dharan suva(n)nee khaR ratan jaRaavee har prem purakh man vuthaa ||
lines.translation: Like the beautiful earth, adorned with jewels of grass - such is the mind, within which the Love of the Lord abides.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਕਾਜ ਸੁਹੇਲੜੇ ਥੀਏ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sabhe kaaj suhelaRe theee gur naanak satigur tuthaa ||1||
lines.translation: All one's affairs are easily resolved, O Nanak, when the Guru, the True Guru, is pleased. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਦੀ ਫਿਰਦੀ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਾ ਜਲ ਪਰਬਤ ਬਨਰਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: phiradee phiradee dah disaa jal parabat banaraai ||
lines.translation: Roaming and wandering in the ten directions, over water, mountains and forests

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਡਿਠਾ ਮਿਰਤਕੋ ਇਲ ਬਹਿਠੀ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jithai dithaa miratako il bahithee aai ||2||
lines.translation: - wherever the vulture sees a dead body, he flies down and lands. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਫਲ ਲੋੜੀਅਹਿ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis sarab sukhaa phal loReeahi so sach kamaavau ||
lines.translation: One who longs for all comforts and rewards should practice Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੇੜੈ ਦੇਖਉ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: neRai dekhau paarabraham ik naam dhiaavau ||
lines.translation: Behold the Supreme Lord God near you, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hoi sagal kee renukaa har sa(n)g samaavau ||
lines.translation: Become the dust of all men's feet, and so merge with the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਕਿਸੈ ਜੀਅ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dookh na deee kisai jee pat siu ghar jaavau ||
lines.translation: Do not cause any being to suffer, and you shall go to your true home with honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣਾਵਉ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: patit puneet karataa purakh naanak sunaavau ||17||
lines.translation: Nanak speaks of the Purifier of sinners, the Creator, the Primal Being. ||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਦੋਹਾ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok dohaa mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Dohaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਜਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੈ ਕੀਆ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek j saajan mai keeaa sarab kalaa samarath ||
lines.translation: I have made the One Lord my Friend; He is All-powerful to do everything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸੰਦੜੀ ਵਥੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jeeu hamaaraa kha(n)neeai har man tan sa(n)daRee vath ||1||
lines.translation: My soul is a sacrifice to Him; the Lord is the treasure of my mind and body. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕਰੁ ਗਹਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਾ ਮੂਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: je kar gahahi piaaraRe tudh na chhodaa mool ||
lines.translation: Take my hand, O my Beloved; I shall never forsake You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਛੋਡਨਿ ਸੇ ਦੁਰਜਨਾ ਪੜਹਿ ਦੋਜਕ ਕੈ ਸੂਲਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har chhodan se durajanaa paRahi dojak kai sool ||2||
lines.translation: Those who forsake the Lord, are the most evil people; they shall fall into the horrible pit of hell. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਘਰਿ ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh nidhaan ghar jis dai har kare s hovai ||
lines.translation: All treasures are in His Home; whatever the Lord does, comes to pass.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਪਾਪਾ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap jap jeevahi sa(n)t jan paapaa mal dhovai ||
lines.translation: The Saints live by chanting and meditating on the Lord, washing off the filth of their sins.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਹਿ ਸੰਕਟ ਸਭਿ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal hiradai vasahi sa(n)kat sabh khovai ||
lines.translation: With the Lotus Feet of the Lord dwelling within the heart, all misfortune is taken away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa jis bheteeai mar janam na rovai ||
lines.translation: One who meets the Perfect Guru, shall not have to suffer through birth and death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵੈ ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: prabh daras piaas naanak ghanee kirapaa kar devai ||18||
lines.translation: Nanak is thirsty for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan; by His Grace, He has bestowed it. ||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਡਖਣਾ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok dakhanaa mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Dakhanaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੋਰੀ ਭਰਮੁ ਵਞਾਇ ਪਿਰੀ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਹਿਕੁ ਤੂ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhoree bharam vanjaai piree muhabat hik too ||
lines.translation: If you can dispel your doubts, even for an instant, and love your only Beloved,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥਹੁ ਵੰਞੈ ਜਾਇ ਤਿਥਾਊ ਮਉਜੂਦੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jithahu va(n)njai jaai tithaaoo maujood soi ||1||
lines.translation: then wherever you go, there you shall find Him. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੜਿ ਕੈ ਘੋੜੜੈ ਕੁੰਦੇ ਪਕੜਹਿ ਖੂੰਡੀ ਦੀ ਖੇਡਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaR kai ghoRaRai ku(n)de pakaRahi khoo(n)dee dee khedaaree ||
lines.translation: Can they mount horses and handle guns, if all they know is the game of polo?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੰਸਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਉਲਾਸਹਿ ਕੁਕੜ ਦੀ ਓਡਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ha(n)saa setee chit ulaasahi kukaR dee odaaree ||2||
lines.translation: Can they be swans, and fulfill their conscious desires, if they can only fly like chickens? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਉਚਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣੈ ਸੋ ਉਧਰੈ ਮਿਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: rasanaa ucharai har sravanee sunai so udharai mitaa ||
lines.translation: Those who chant the Lord's Name with their tongues and hear it with their ears are saved, O my friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲਿਖਹਿ ਲਾਇ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਸੇ ਹਸਤ ਪਵਿਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jas likhahi laai bhaavanee se hasat pavitaa ||
lines.translation: Those hands which lovingly write the Praises of the Lord are pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨਾ ਸਭਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਿਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: athasath teerath majanaa sabh pu(n)n tin kitaa ||
lines.translation: It is like performing all sorts of virtuous deeds, and bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਤੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਗੜੁ ਜਿਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)saar saagar te udhare bikhiaa gaR jitaa ||
lines.translation: They cross over the world-ocean, and conquer the fortress of corruption.
